description: Na₂Ba₂B₁₀H₂O₁₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four BO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.74 Å. Ba is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to one H and eleven O atoms. The Ba-H bond length is 2.85 Å. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.75-3.05 Å. There are five inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.37 Å) and one longer (1.40 Å) B-O bond length. In the second B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid and corners with two BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.52 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two BO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.53 Å. In the fourth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.36-1.39 Å. In the fifth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid and corners with three BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.51 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Ba and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ba, and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ba and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Ba and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ba, one B, and one H atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ba, and two B atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Ba and two B atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Ba and two B atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Ba and two equivalent B atoms.
